limits: Only local cost_and_settlement dimension lifecycle is accepted by this engineering checkpoint.
No real provider requests, credentials, live backend, Auth0 or practitioner sign-off.
FakeBank is isolated in-memory SQLite, with synthetic humans and business evidence.
E01 changes present in integrated parent runtime were not accepted by this scope.
Future QBO settlement export and tax integration are excluded.
